clippings.speaker: Evan Goldberg
clippings.quote: And if it started to get disbalanced, our writing would suck. We counterbalance one another quite well.
clippings.title: THE GREEN HORNET On Set Interview Seth Rogen Evan Goldberg
clippings.context: Same on-set interview, following Rogen's answer that their partnership has no leader.

clippings.speaker: Evan Goldberg
clippings.quote: We were children, and our brains forged a thing where it's like, “This is how you write with another person.” So we just learned how to write together–and can't ignore the truth that we are just better together than apart.
clippings.title: Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg Open Up On Sequels: “We’re Not Opposed to Revisiting Some”
clippings.context: Joint interview, asked the secret to their creative partnership lasting so long.

clippings.speaker: Evan Goldberg
clippings.quote: But no, Seth just works harder than everyone else. That's nice. He works harder than me. That's what I appreciate the most, is having a partner who works harder than me because who doesn't want that?
clippings.title: Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg Open Up On Sequels: “We’re Not Opposed to Revisiting Some”
clippings.context: Same interview, asked what each admires most about the other's work.

clippings.speaker: Seth Rogen
clippings.quote: Evan co-wrote this movie. There's not a lot that we have done without each other [chuckles], but Evan made this movie with Jay Baruchel that is amazing.
clippings.title: Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg Open Up On Sequels: “We’re Not Opposed to Revisiting Some”
clippings.context: Same interview, asked for his favorite project of Goldberg's.

clippings.speaker: Evan Goldberg
clippings.quote: Maybe there were 10 nerds, back when nerd was still an insult, who read comic books in my grade and the only one I connected with was Seth.
clippings.title: A kingpin of comedy
